sources.beginner: hand-calc: calendar rules taught in src/content/courses/compliance/beginner/m02-m05 (earlier of two dates, rollForward, periodStart, review date at issue); Suite Regulatory Compliance/Document Control read the machine clock and panels are pinned to the IKORO teaching case.
sources.intermediate: hand-calc: planProgress/checklistProgress half-up rules and ncrAgeDays taught in intermediate/m01-m05; Suite QA Plan dashboard (src/pages/apps/assurance/qa-plan/Dashboard.jsx:153-157) prints the same figures but only against new Date().
sources.advanced: hand-calc: coverage, evidenced claims, finding age and certificate days taught in advanced/m01-m05; Suite ISO Compliance reads new Date() (src/pages/apps/assurance/iso-compliance/Dashboard.jsx:53).

fields.prompt_precision: "Give six whole numbers" / "Work in whole calendar days from the as-of date"
fields.evidence: Next action date = earlier of due 2027-02-28 and expiry 2026-12-19 (taught in l04), 2026-10-15 to 2026-12-19 = 65 days; integer quantity, tol 0.5 accepts exactly 65.
fields.notes: Suite assurance apps read the machine clock (e.g. src/pages/apps/assurance/regulatory-compliance/Register.jsx:61 `const today = new Date()`), so they only reproduce these day counts on 2026-10-15 itself; NextGen panels are pinned to the IKORO/ABAM/ORASHI teaching cases and panelCapstoneGuard.test.js refuses capstone answers. The learner works it by hand from taught rules; a spreadsheet date subtraction is exact. Copy nit: beginner/m01/l02-a-date-is-a-day.md:35 says "You are not asked to count days on a calendar yourself", which the capstone then requires.

fields.evidence: rollForward from the date that was due (2026-10-31, semi-annual) to 2027-04-30 (month-end pull-back taught in m04/l02); 197 whole days, integer with tol 0.5.

fields.evidence: Review date is earned at issue (2025-01-31 + 30 months, month-end pulled back), the correction date does not move it (l02); 289 days, integer.

fields.prompt_precision: "Give six whole numbers" / "Work in whole calendar days from the as-of date"
fields.evidence: 2024-05-31 + 16 months = 2025-09-30 (month end pulled back); -380 days, integer with tol 0.5.

fields.prompt_precision: "Give six whole numbers" / "Work in whole calendar days from the as-of date"
fields.evidence: planProgress = resolved/total rounded half up, the rule stated with four worked cases at l05:33; a learner computes the exact fraction and rounds, so tol 0.5 on the integer 67 is honest.

fields.prompt_precision: "Give six whole numbers" / "Work in whole calendar days from the as-of date"
fields.evidence: Each request is put to the gate rules taught in m01/l02-l04 and m02/l04 (waive needs a reason, set-aside needs date/name/reason, removal of a hold point refused, etc.), then planProgress half up (l05:33) gives 80.
fields.notes: Probe hit 55 in PlanExplorer ("Progress, counted by the engine55 percent" after "Remove W-09") is an ABAM teaching state, unrelated to this field; no leak.

fields.prompt_precision: "Give six whole numbers" / "Work in whole calendar days from the as-of date"
fields.evidence: ncrAgeDays = as-of minus raised while open (l04:3); NCR-2026-044 raised 2026-05-06 gives 162, an integer.

fields.prompt_precision: "as the dashboard rounds it: to a whole day, half up"
fields.evidence: Mean of the four open ages (162, 88, 23, 41) = 78.5, rounded half up to 79 as the prompt states; tol 0.5 also admits the unrounded 78.5.
fields.notes: Suite QA Plan dashboard prints `Mean age ${summary.meanOpenNcrAgeDays} days` (src/pages/apps/assurance/qa-plan/Dashboard.jsx:157) but against the machine clock (Dashboard.jsx:50).

fields.prompt_precision: "Give six whole numbers" / "Work in whole calendar days from the as-of date"
fields.evidence: checklistProgress: answered the engine accepts (N/A needs a reason, so 13+3+2+2 = 20) over 27, half up = 74 (rule at l02:24).

fields.prompt_precision: "Give six whole numbers" / "Work in whole calendar days from the as-of date"
fields.evidence: programmeProgress = reported (Closed+Reported = 6) over total 11 (cancelled stay in the denominator, the ABAM case prints 3 of 8 = 38) = 54.5, half up 55; tol 0.5 also admits the unrounded 54.5.
fields.notes: Probe number 55 appears in PlanExplorer as an ITP progress after "Remove W-09" on the ABAM case, a coincidence, not a leak of this field.
